verification.command:
python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json,re,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.agent/run_state.json').read_text()); e=[x for x in r['history'] if x.get('event')=='release_executed' and x.get('tag')=='v1.5.0'][-1]
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','v1.5.0^{commit}'],text=True).strip(); assert e['commit']==sha
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('.agent/evidence/102/ga-readiness.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='d98ccec0f3c57cda51876db3286b57005143ef771b88b4c92f36748de4c0f590'
road=Path('docs/planning/ROADMAP.md').read_text().split('\n---\n',1)[1]; current=road.split('## Current Position',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]; assert current.count('Latest released tag: v1.5.0')==1 and 'Release in preparation: v1.5.0' not in current; assert sha in current
h=Path('docs/planning/HANDOVER.md').read_text(); note=h.split('## Current status — 2026-10-10',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]; assert 'Phase 014 is complete.' in note; assert 'Features 100 and 101 were cancelled' in note; assert 'General Availability' in note and 'v1.5.0' in note and 'historical' in note
g=Path('docs/planning/operator_gates.md').read_text(); line=[x for x in g.splitlines() if x.startswith('| `H-FRAMEWORK-RELEASE`')][0]; assert all(x in line for x in ['v1.5.0','EXECUTED',sha]); ga=[x for x in g.splitlines() if x.startswith('| `H-GA`')][0]; assert all(x in ga for x in ['EXECUTED','not_met','insufficient_evidence'])
release=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','release','view','v1.5.0','--json','tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,publishedAt,url'],text=True)); assert release['tagName']=='v1.5.0' and not release['isDraft'] and not release['isPrerelease'] and release['publishedAt']
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','v1.5.0:CHANGELOG.md'],text=True); c=Path('CHANGELOG.md').read_text(); assert c[c.index('## [1.5.0]'):]==base[base.index('## [1.5.0]'):]
baseline=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','v1.5.0:docs/planning/manifest.json'],text=True)); manifest=json.loads(Path('docs/planning/manifest.json').read_text()); phase=next(x for x in manifest['phases'] if x['id']=='014-ga-track'); original=next(x for x in baseline['phases'] if x['id']=='014-ga-track'); assert phase['note'].startswith(original['note']); assert 'Post-phase release: v1.5.0' in phase['note'][len(original['note']):] and sha in phase['note'][len(original['note']):]; phase['note']=original['note']; assert manifest==baseline
print('PASS published release facts, current planning/handover, GA exceptions and immutable released notes')
CHECK
